description: This is a BitBake recipe file (.inc) that defines how to fetch, configure, build, and install the Bluez (Linux Bluetooth Stack) version 5.48 source code. It includes metadata, dependencies, patching instructions, build flags, package definitions, and installation procedures for the Bluez userland components.

methods.name: get_noinst_tools_paths
methods.description: Helper function to generate full paths for no-install tools based on the 'NOINST_TOOLS' variable, in the BitBake build environment.
